card.name: Inside split medical words
card.fires_on: The middle or ending piece of a longer medical word split into parts, such as the 'ip' in constipating, 'oring' in snoring, 'lux' in reflux and 'oid' in hemorrhoid. It is strongest in words for body-function problems.
